candidates.change_summary: Change seedMarket to set initialized to false instead of true, so initialized differs after call.
Change seedMarket to omit setting initialized (delete the initialized assignment), leaving initialized at prior value (likely false) so observable differs if original set it true.
Change seedMarket to set initialized only when msg.value is nonzero, causing initialized to differ depending on call (observable behavior change).
Set initialized to the negation of its previous value (toggle) during seedMarket, so its value after the call differs from original deterministic true.
Replace the require check so DrugDealer can be called by anyone; assign ceoAddress to msg.sender (allows any caller to become CEO).
Invert the require to require caller NOT be the current CEO; then set ceoAddress to msg.sender (prevents CEO from reassigning to self but lets others become CEO).
Change the assignment so ceoAddress is set to a fixed address (overwrites CEO to a constant), independent of msg.sender.
Remove the require and set ceoAddress to tx.origin instead of msg.sender (changes who becomes CEO when called via contract).
Keep require but flip assignment to set ceoAddress to address(this) (contract becomes its own CEO).
Replace referral assignment so a caller cannot set a referral for themselves by requiring ref != msg.sender before assigning referrals[msg.sender]=ref.
Change referral bonus recipient from referrals[msg.sender] to ceoAddress, giving the CEO the 20% referral share instead.
Change market increment from drugsUsed/10 to drugsUsed/2, increasing marketDrugs growth and affecting future Kilos calculations.
Move lastCollect update earlier so lastCollect[msg.sender] is set before claimedDrugs[referral] and marketDrugs updates (changes getDrugsSinceLastCollect timing for external observers).
Change newKilo calculation to use DRUGS_TO_PRODUCE_1KILO/2, doubling kilos produced per drugsUsed and altering Kilos updates.
